tools.name: recommend_supplements
tools.description: HerStack's named Solgar UK supplement recommendations for a women's-health concern or cluster, each with formulation rationale and the authorised health claim (or a research-context note). Provide either `cluster` or `concern`.

tools.name: get_cluster_brief
tools.description: The editorial brief for a HerStack cluster: framing, research findings, the evidence table, brand criteria, and a plain-language FAQ that also explains the condition itself (what perimenopause is, its timeline, contraception, when to see a GP). Citation provenance is carried as source labels.

tools.name: assess_concern
tools.description: Route a reader concern to its primary HerStack cluster (and a secondary where relevant), and return that cluster's recommendations.

name: get_evidence
description: Call this when the user (or you) wants the studies behind a recommendation or claim. Returns HerStack's evidence rows for a topic or nutrient with the cited studies resolved to PubMed and DOI identifiers, so the claim can be verified rather than trusted.

name: get_authorised_claims
description: Call this to find what health-claim wording a nutrient is authorised to carry in Great Britain (the GB Nutrition and Health Claims register), as HerStack publishes it, and which HerStack pages and products state it. Returns the authorised wordings verbatim and, separately, nutrients HerStack covers

name: get_product_details
description: Call this for one specific product. Returns a HerStack-recommended Solgar UK product by name or SKU: form, authorised claim, tier, price, purchase link, and every topic that recommends it with the rationale.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "recommend_supplements" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
